messages.content: 誰是英超聯賽中最多助攻的球員？

function.name: sports_analysis_get_top_scorer
function.description: Retrieves the player with most goals in a specific football league Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

league.description: The football league name. Eg. Premier League

season.description: The season in format yyyy/yyyy. Eg. 2020/2021

team.description: Optionally the specific team to consider. Eg. Liverpool

message.content:
截至目前（2023‑24 賽季結束時），英超聯賽本賽季助攻最多的是曼城的 Kevin De Bruyne，總計 20 次助攻。  
如果你想知道歷史上英超聯賽助攻最多的球員，那就是前曼聯球星 Ryan Giggs，職業生涯在英超共送出 190 次助攻。
message.reasoning: User asks: "誰是英超聯賽中最多助攻的球員？" They want top assist provider in Premier League. We can use function sports_analysis_get_top_scorer? But that's for goals. There's no function for assists. So we need to answer manually. Provide answer: According to current stats up to 2025? Actually as of 2023-24 season, top assist provider is Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) with 20 assists. But maybe they want all-time record: Most assists in Premier League history: Ryan Giggs (190). Or current season? The question ambiguous. Provide answer: As of 2023-24 season, top assist provider is Kevin De Bruyne. Also mention all-time record: Ryan Giggs.
